title: 10-15 Posts a Day, Zero Content Dumps | vitalii.no
description:
I was publishing 10 to 15 articles a day, often all within minutes of each other. On social feeds that read as a content dump — an instant way to alienate followers, trigger unfollows, and get penalized by the algorithm. Manually staggering posts across LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook ate up real time every day.

A scheduler now runs every five minutes via GitHub Actions, pulling from a queue and enforcing a minimum gap between publications. Every post carries an AI-derived priority score, so breaking news jumps straight to the front while routine posts wait their turn. Configurable publish windows keep everything inside sensible hours.

Manual scheduling is gone — about 30 minutes saved every day — and engagement is up 15 to 20% now that posts land at a steady, algorithm-friendly pace.
